$comment: Machine-checkable gates for the eighteen presets in references/theme-presets.md.
Read by scripts/verify-preset.mjs. Every value here is transcribed from that
file — accent hexes and radii from each preset's token block, separation and
density from the 'Choosing between them' table, traps from each preset's own
stated trap paragraph. If a preset changes there, change it here.
DELIBERATELY NOT GATED: density and 'does it feel like the direction'.
Density is declared for reporting only — it is a composition judgement, and a
gate on it would give false confidence. See the limits section in the runner.

universal.$comment: From the five disciplines + the ship checklist. Apply to every preset.

imageryAdvisory.$comment: ADVISORY, never a failure. Counts decorative imagery (aria-hidden or alt="" , css url() backgrounds, aria-hidden

universalTrap.rule: White text on an accent FILL is forbidden in every preset — theme-presets.md states it once for all of them.
universalTrap.check: no element may render #ffffff text on a background equal to the preset accent

traps.rule: Never ship the pale-card + white-text pairing.

B.name: Blueprint Mono
B.accentNote: This direction has NO accent. The gate inverts: assert no accent-like fill is doing the work of one.

traps.rule: White text on --accent measures 2.07:1. The accent is FILL ONLY.

E.name: Terracotta Commerce
E.separationNote: One of only two shadow presets. theme-presets.md: do not mix shadow and hairline strategies inside one application.

traps.rule: On this dark ground the accent IS a text colour (9.11:1), but its FILL still needs dark ink — white on amber is 2.13:1.
The ghost wordmark sits at 1.14:1. It is decorative texture and must never overlap body copy.
traps.mustNotOverlap: h1, h2, p, li, dd, dt, a, button

H.name: Studio Kinetic
H.separationNote: Second shadow preset — tilted cards need a cast shadow to sit above the grid.

J.name: Charter Navy
J.accentNote: Red marks (metric fills, rules, chip outlines) and is a text colour on white (4.86:1); it never carries text. Actions are navy (--invert) with white, or white inside navy bands.

traps.rule: Red on the navy ground is 3.47:1: never set red type or red icons on a navy section.
The translucent nav must stay at or above 80% opacity: at 72% over a stage band --muted falls to 2.71:1. Only --ink on the glass; dark glass over stage bands.
The studio light sits behind the product only; it must never overlap a heading, paragraph, link or button.
traps.mustNotOverlap: h1, h2, h3, p, li, a, button

M.name: Folio Split
M.accentNote: No accent: all colour on the page arrives in the work. Actions invert (ink fill, white text, 18.43:1).
M.separationNote: Tiles are a tone step with no border and no shadow. The nav pill is the page's one shadow: it is a <nav>, which the separation gate does not count.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane (scripts/showcase-gate.mjs, references/folio-modules.md). Images matching the selector are content: they leave universal.maxAssetKB and meet showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. Budgets are for the file served at the FIRST density.

traps.rule: The art sits under the tile's words, never over them: a tile's art must not overlap its title, sentence, tags or status note, unless the tile is a declared full-bleed tile whose words carry the tile tone under them.

N.name: Sprint Stage
N.accentNote: No accent: the product is the only colour. An action takes the opposite of its ground: a white pill on the stage (ink text, 19.67:1), an ink pill on white.
N.separationNote: Product tiles are a tone step with no border and no shadow; the black banner is the other extreme of the same idea.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane, allowed but not required: a product photograph or render marked data-showcase leaves universal.maxAssetKB and meets showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. A page with none yet still passes; everything not marked stays under the cap.

traps.rule: --stage-ink-2 is 10.42:1 on the stage and 1.95:1 on white. Stage tokens are used only on the two black surfaces, .stage and .banner.
Text over a photograph cannot be measured: the hero product never overlaps the stage's heading, sentence or button. Below 768 px it moves under them.

O.name: Olive Outfitter
O.accentNote: The olive carries white at 7.11:1, so the pairing is declared and measured. Lightened to #7a7f58 it is 4.20:1, a fail.
O.separationNote: Nested rounded panels with 1px outlines. No shadows anywhere: that is Terracotta Commerce.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane, allowed but not required: a product photograph or render marked data-showcase leaves universal.maxAssetKB and meets showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. A page with none yet still passes; everything not marked stays under the cap.

traps.rule: A fact card sits on the photograph. Text on a translucent card over a picture cannot be measured, so the card is fully opaque.
The copy column is solid tone and the photograph is a separate box beside it, masked at its near edge. The photograph never overlaps a heading, sentence or link of its panel.
traps.mustNotOverlap: .hero__copy h1, .hero__copy p, .hero__copy a, .hero__copy button, .cat h3, .cat p, .cat a

P.name: Chamfer Spec
P.accentNote: No accent: black does the work (buttons, the spec label, the angled band; white on it is 19.79:1).
P.separationNote: Cells are divided by hairlines and the spec strip is outlined. No shadows and no rounded corners.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane, allowed but not required: a product photograph or render marked data-showcase leaves universal.maxAssetKB and meets showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. A page with none yet still passes; everything not marked stays under the cap.

traps.rule: clip-path on a control clips its own outline, so the keyboard focus ring vanishes. The cut is painted by a ::before layer; the control keeps clip-path: none.
traps.selector: a[href], button, input, select, textarea, summary, [tabindex]

traps.rule: Text over a picture cannot be measured: a render and its ring graphics never overlap a heading, paragraph, list item, link or button. A callout sits beside the render.
traps.mustNotOverlap: h1, h2, h3, p, li, dt, dd, a, button

Q.name: Market Shelf
Q.accentNote: No accent: one midnight band per page, and the same midnight fills the buttons (white on it is 18.52:1).
Q.separationNote: White cards on the pale aisle: a tone step with no border and no shadow. The rule inside a card's foot is not a card outline.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane, allowed but not required: a product photograph or render marked data-showcase leaves universal.maxAssetKB and meets showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. A page with none yet still passes; everything not marked stays under the cap.

traps.rule: The bright star yellow is 1.84:1 on a white card. On light grounds stars take --rating (4.64:1) and are followed by the number as text; the bright yellow is for the midnight band only.
A shelf whose track is overflow: hidden shows nothing past its fifth card without script, on touch or from the keyboard. The track is overflow-x: auto; the arrows only scroll it.

R.name: Mono Catalogue
R.accentNote: No accent and no colour in the pictures. Actions invert (ink fill, white text, 18.88:1).
R.separationNote: Tiles are a tone step with no border and no shadow. The rule under the filter row is not a surface outline.

showcase.$comment: The showcase lane, allowed but not required: a product photograph or render marked data-showcase leaves universal.maxAssetKB and meets showcase-markup, showcase-sharpness and showcase-weight instead. A page with none yet still passes; everything not marked stays under the cap.

traps.rule: With no accent, the first picture left in colour becomes the accent by accident. Every art box carries filter: grayscale(1), even when the export is already grey.
The cut-out leans off the tile's corner under the words, never over them.
